main_text.p: allaborarunt : & in eo perstitêre ad cre-scentem usq; potentiam Macedonum. Post mortem verò Alexandri magni astu regum Macedoniæ concordia in-ter eos rupta, urbium societas soluta, & in contraria studia scissa est : earum quibusdam præsidia Macedonica à De-metrio, Cassandro, Antigono Gonatâ imposita, aliæ à tyrannis occupatæ. Eaque confusio duravit ad ultimos an-nos Olympiadis cxxiiii, Pyrrho rege Epiri jam in Italiam transgresso. Tum velut ad meliorem mentem reversi primi Patrenses & Dimæi, mox & Pharæenses ac Tritæenses repetito vetere instituto propius se rursum junxerunt, & velut in unam civitatem coïverunt. His à quadriennio, cum flueret jam an-nus quintus, Ægienses accessere ejecto præsidio suo, & pòst Burii occiso ty-ranno, ac sensim alii post alios tyran-nis liberati, donec tandem omnes regionis istius urbes pristinæ societati se reddiderunt, exceptis Oleno & Helice: quarum ista reliquis se jungere recusa-vit, hæc vi fluctuum biennium ante pu-gnam Leuctricam absorpta fuit. Quin-etiam præter istas Achaici soli urbes alias quoque complures, & paulatim omnes feré quæ in Peloponneso erant, [illegible, ~6 letters] edam etiam extra Peloponnefum, huic

page.notes: Right and left edge strips show parts of the facing page and the binding edge; not transcribed. Bottom left shows ghosted show-through from the other side, with garbled characters; not transcribed. The line beginning "[illegible, ~6 letters] edam" is overprinted by a shadow and cannot be read reliably. "cxxiiii" is read from a small scan and may be cxxiii or cxxiiii. Printed "ųsq;" read as "usq;" and "flućtuum" as "fluctuum"; both forms are doubtful. The final line "huic" is taken as catchword.
